chunks.text: Today, we will talk about Tajikistan.
Tajikistan is a mountainous, peaceful, and historic country in Central Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Tajikistan?
Tajikistan is in Central Asia.
It is next to Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, China, and Afghanistan.
It is a landlocked country, which means it has no sea.
It has many mountains and rivers.
What is the capital city of Tajikistan?
The capital city is Dushanbe.
Dushanbe is the largest city in the country.
It has wide streets, parks, museums, and markets.
The name Dushanbe means Monday in Persian.
Other towns include Kujand in the north, Korug in the high mountains, Kulob in the south.
How many people live in Tajikistan?
About 10 million people live in Tajikistan.
Most people live in valleys and cities, because the mountains are hard to live in.
What language do people speak in Tajikistan?
The official language is Tajik.
Tajik is a form of Persian.
People also speak Russian, used in business and government.
Some people speak Uzbek, Kyrgyz, or Pamiri languages in mountain areas.
What is the weather like in Tajikistan?
Tajikistan has a continental climate.
Hot summers, dry and sunny.
Cold winters with snow, especially in the mountains.
Spring and autumn, cool and pleasant.
In the mountains, it is cold most of the year.
What does Tajikistan look like?
Tajikistan has tall mountains like the Pamir Mountains, glaciers and high lakes, green valleys and rivers, small villages and stone houses.
Over 90 % of the land is mountainous.
It is a country of natural beauty.
What animals live in Tajikistan?
Tajikistan is home to snow leopards, wolves and bears, Ibex and Marco Polo sheep in the highlands, eagles, hawks and vultures, yaks, goats and sheep on farms.
Wild animals live mostly in the remote mountains.
What do people eat in Tajikistan?
Tajik food is simple, warm and hearty.
People eat bread called naan with almost every meal.
Rice, noodles and potatoes, meat usually lamb or beef, yogurt, onions, carrots and herbs.

Popular dishes, plov, rice with meat and carrots, national dish, lagman, hand -pulled noodles with meat and vegetables, shorba, meat and vegetable soup, manti, steamed dumplings, sambusa, baked pastry with meter vegetables.
What do people drink in Tajikistan?
People drink tea, green or black, served with every meal, water, milk and sometimes yogurt drinks.
In summer, compote a fruit drink.
Alcohol is not common, especially in rural areas.
Tea is a big part of hospitality in Tajikistan.
What is life like in Tajikistan?
Life in Tajikistan is often rural, traditional and family -centered.
People enjoy working in farms or gardens, visiting neighbors, drinking tea and talking, celebrating holidays, sewing, weaving and music.
Many families grow their own fruits and vegetables.
What are some holidays and traditions?

Navru's Spring Festival on March 23rd, Independence Day, September 9th, Eid al -Fitr and Eid al -Adha Muslim holidays, weddings, big events with music, food and dancing, traditional dress, colorful robes called Atlas or Chapan.
People enjoy folk music, dancing and poetry.
Some fun facts about Tajikistan.
It is home to the third highest mountain in the former Soviet Union.
The Pamir Highway is one of the highest roads in the world.
The flag is red, white and green with a crown and stars.
Most people follow Islam, but there are also cultural festivals.
Tajik embroidery and handicrafts are famous in Central Asia.
Now you know many things about Tajikistan.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the mountains, the tea and the traditions.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
